Reason for Mistake: The Coder incorrectly identified the word "left" in the sentence as the target word to be reversed. The task explicitly asks to write the opposite of the "left word". In standard English grammar and logic, "the left word" refers to the word located on the left side of the sentence (which is "If"), not the word with the semantic meaning "left". Consequently, the Coder should have identified "If" as the target, found its opposite (which is "Right"), and outputted "Right". Instead, the Coder selected the word "left", found its opposite ("right"), and the subsequent Planner incorrectly accepted this flawed logic.
